title: 第3章 继续猎妖第4章 青狐幼崽
content_zh:
第3章继续猎妖
回顾与枯叶蛇的战斗过程，刘长旭发现自己斗法能力存在着很大不足。
火球术的催发速度不快！威力不足！用来对敌很是吃力。
看来以后，除了在功法修炼上下功夫，不断进阶突破外，对法术的修炼也不能放松，也只有将法术习练到圆满才能在对敌斗法中多几分胜算。
刘长旭目前修炼的是黄阶上品功法培元炼气决，这门功法是一部无属性功法。
优点是这门功法对修炼者灵根属性没有要求，什么灵根都可以修炼，修炼出来的法力也比较中正平和，很适合炼气期修士修炼。
缺点则是，修炼这部功法的修士斗法能力较为平庸。
桃山刘家只是一个普通的炼气家族，立族时间也不长，家族收藏的功法数量不多，品阶也不高。
刘氏家族收藏功法中品阶最高的一部功法也只是一部玄级下品功法。这部功法也只有炼气部分内容，且与刘长旭的灵根属性不合。
刘长旭修炼的这部培元炼气决已是刘家目前收藏的最好一部功法了。
能在外面买到的功法绝大部分都是黄阶功法，玄阶以上的功法大都掌握在大型宗门和家族手中。
这些宗门和家族都将玄阶以上功法当做宗门道统传承之根本，绝对不允许外流。
修仙功法共分天、地、玄、黄四个品阶。
其中，以黄阶功法品质最差。相比修炼高阶功法的修士，修炼黄阶功法修士在修行中遇到的瓶颈较多，进阶难度较大，且修炼出的法力质量普遍不高，在与敌斗法时很是吃亏！
只是由于黄阶功法的取得较为容易，且修炼难度较低，消耗的修仙资源少的缘故，绝大部分散修和小型修仙家族修士都只能无奈选择黄阶功法。
玄阶功法是大型宗门和家族子弟修炼的主流功法，它的修炼难度相对较高，但修炼玄阶功法所遇到的瓶颈较少，且法力品质不错。
地阶功法修炼的法力质量和进阶难度则要比玄、黄阶功法好的多。往往是大型宗门和家族中优秀弟子才能修炼的功法，也被视为宗门道统根基！大部分元婴修士修炼都是地阶功法。
而天阶功法即使在大型宗门和大型家族中能有一两部就很不错了，有的大型宗门和家族连一部天阶功法也没有，被视为宗门最核心的传承，只有宗主一脉或最核心弟子才能修炼，功法往往是艰涩难懂，且需要特殊珍贵的灵物用来辅助修炼
在初步适应了猎妖活动后，刘长旭结合长辈族人传授的经验和自己参加猎妖行动的一点心得，对搜寻妖兽灵物也总结了一些自己的行动办法。
用灵眼术进行远处观察时，首先要看灵气浓度，灵气越是浓厚，存在灵药灵物及妖兽的可能性越高。一阶灵脉很可能会存在一阶妖兽或灵物灵药，二阶灵脉往往会存在二阶妖兽或灵物灵药。所以，搜寻的重点是具有灵脉和灵气之地。

刘长旭修炼的灵眼术是黄阶法术金光眼，掐动法诀双目浮现一缕金光扫视前方的山峦！
远处的山峦在刘长旭眼中立即清晰无比，空气之中也发现了淡淡的各色灵气，其中，最多的是青色的木属性灵气。
忽然，刘长旭发现在前方大山山腰处的一片丛林中，一株一尺高的小树颇有些不同，木属性灵气较为浓郁。
刘长旭立即发动轻身术，向着这棵小树而去。只见刘长旭一步三丈，在崎岖不平的山坡上，如履平地奇快无比。普通凡人难以行走的悬崖陡壁，也能轻松而上。
刘长旭很快就来到这株小树五十丈处。有了刚才的教训后，刘长旭此时心中无比小心谨慎。
在仔细观察辨别后，刘长旭发现这是一株灵茶树，名云雾茶，常饮此茶能清脑醒神，有一丝增强修仙者神识悟性的能力。且树龄越大，出产的灵茶质量越好！

Chapter 3 Continue to hunt monsters
Looking back on the battle with the Dead Leaf Snake, Liu Changxu found that there were great deficiencies in his fighting ability.
The activation speed of the fireball technique is not fast! Not powerful enough! It is very difficult to use against enemies.
It seems that in the future, in addition to working hard on the cultivation of skills and constantly advancing and making breakthroughs, we cannot relax in the practice of spells. Only by practicing the spells to perfection can we have a better chance of winning in the battle with the enemy.
Liu Changxu is currently practicing the Huang-level top-grade Kung Fu, the Qi-Pui Yuan Refining Technique, which is a non-attributed Kung Fu.
The advantage is that this technique has no requirements on the spiritual root attributes of the cultivator. Any spiritual root can be cultivated, and the mana produced is relatively moderate and peaceful, making it very suitable for cultivators in the Qi refining period.
The disadvantage is that the monks who practice this technique have relatively mediocre fighting abilities.
The Taoshan Liu family is just an ordinary qi-refining family. It has not been established for a long time. The number of martial arts collected by the family is not large, and the grade is not high.
The highest-grade technique among the Liu family's collection of techniques is only a low-grade Xuan-level technique. This exercise only contains the Qi refining part, and is inconsistent with Liu Changxu's spiritual root attributes.
The Yuan Peiyuan Qi Refining Technique practiced by Liu Changxu is already the best technique in the Liu family's collection.
Most of the exercises that can be bought outside are yellow-level exercises, and most of the exercises above the Xuan level are in the hands of large sects and families.
These sects and families all regard the skills above the Xuan level as the foundation of the sect's inheritance and will never allow them to leak out.
The cultivation techniques of immortality are divided into four levels: Heaven, Earth, Xuan and Huang.
Among them, the Huangjie Kung Fu has the worst quality. Compared with monks who practice high-level skills, monks who practice yellow-level skills encounter more bottlenecks in their practice, it is more difficult to advance, and the quality of the magic they cultivate is generally not high, so they suffer a lot when fighting with the enemy!
It's just that because the yellow-level skills are easier to obtain, the difficulty of cultivation is lower, and they consume less resources for cultivating immortals, most casual cultivators and small cultivator families have no choice but to choose the yellow-level skills.
Xuanjie Cultivation Technique is a mainstream technique practiced by the children of large sects and families. It is relatively difficult to practice, but there are fewer bottlenecks in practicing Xuanjie Cultivation Technique, and the quality of the magic power is good.
The quality of mana and the difficulty of advancing in the Earth-level exercises are much better than those of the Xuan and Huang-level exercises. The exercises are often practiced only by outstanding disciples in large sects and families, and are also regarded as the foundation of the sect's tradition! Most Nascent Soul monks practice earth-level techniques.
Even if there are one or two heaven-level exercises in large sects and large families, it would be great. Some large sects and families do not even have one heaven-level exercise. They are regarded as the core inheritance of the sect and can only be practiced by the lineage of the sect master or the core disciples. The exercises are often difficult to understand and require special and precious spiritual objects to assist in practice.
After initially adapting to the monster hunting activities, Liu Changxu also summarized some of his own methods for searching for monsters and spiritual objects based on the experience taught by his elders and his own experience in monster hunting.
When using spiritual eyes to observe from a distance, you must first look at the concentration of spiritual energy. The thicker the spiritual energy, the higher the possibility of the existence of elixirs, spiritual objects and monsters. The first-level spiritual veins are likely to contain first-level monsters or spiritual creatures and elixirs, while the second-level spiritual veins often contain second-level demonic beasts or spiritual creatures and elixirs. Therefore, the focus of the search is the place with spiritual veins and spiritual energy.
The spiritual eye technique that Liu Changxu practiced was the yellow-level golden light eye. When he used the technique, a ray of golden light appeared in his eyes and he scanned the mountains in front of him!
The mountains in the distance were immediately clear to Liu Changxu's eyes, and faint auras of various colors were also found in the air, the most common of which was cyan wood-attribute aura.
Suddenly, Liu Changxu discovered that in a jungle on the mountainside ahead, a one-foot-tall tree was somewhat different, with a stronger wood-attribute aura.
Liu Changxu immediately activated his light body technique and headed towards the small tree. I saw Liu Changxu taking one step at a time, walking on the rugged road.On the hillside, it was as fast as walking on flat ground. Steep cliffs that are difficult for ordinary mortals to walk on can also be climbed easily.
Liu Changxu soon came to the small tree fifty feet away. After learning the lesson just now, Liu Changxu was extremely cautious at this time.
After careful observation and identification, Liu Changxu discovered that this was a spiritual tea tree, named Yunwu Tea. Regular drinking of this tea can clear the brain and refresh the mind, and has the ability to enhance the spiritual consciousness of cultivators. And the older the tree, the better the quality of the spiritual tea it produces!
